title: Letter Lagoon
blurb: Learn what letters say, then read your very first words!

stops.title: m, a, t
stops.why: Letters are a secret code for sounds. Learn the code and you can read!

learn.text: m says mmm, like the start of monkey.
a says the sound at the start of apple.
learn.say: The letter a. It says the sound at the start of apple.

learn.text: t says the sound at the start of tiger.
learn.say: The letter t. It says the sound at the start of tiger.

story.title: Tam the Crab
pages: Tam is a little blue crab who lives in the bay.
Tam loves to sit on her mat in the warm sun.
Splash! A big wave takes Tam's mat away!
Her friend Max the turtle swims out and gets it.
"Thank you, Max!" says Tam. Now they share the mat.

practice.text: Read the name. Who is it?
practice.why: T, a, m. Put the sounds together and you get Tam. Tam is the little crab!
practice.hint: Look at the first letter. Is it t, like tiger, or m, like monkey?

how.name: Tap and Blend
steps: Touch each letter and say its sound.
Slide your finger under the word and blend the sounds together.
Now you try it!

practice.text: Which letter makes the sound at the start of monkey?
practice.sayText: Which letter makes the sound at the start of monkey? Mmm, monkey.
practice.why: Monkey starts with mmm. The letter m says mmm.
practice.hint: Say monkey slowly. Mmm-onkey. Which letter hums like that?

how.name: Hear the First Sound
steps: Say the word slowly and stretch the first sound.
Think: which letter makes that sound?
Now you try it!

practice.text: Build the word mat. Tap the letters in order.

say.a: the sound at the start of apple
say.t: the sound at the start of tiger

practice.why: Mat starts with mmm, then the sound in apple, then the sound in tiger. M, a, t.
practice.hint: Say mat slowly. What sound do you hear first?

how.name: Say It, Build It
steps: Say the word slowly, one sound at a time.
Find the letter for the first sound, then the next, then the last.
Now you try it!

practice.text: Does it start like monkey or like tiger?
practice.why: Mouse and moon start with mmm, like monkey. Tomato and teddy start like tiger.
practice.hint: Say each picture's name. Listen to the very first sound.

how.name: Listen for the First Sound
steps: Say the picture's name out loud.
Is the first sound like monkey or like tiger?
Now you try it!

practice.why: This word is a, then t. It says at, not am. Am ends with mmm.
practice.hint: Look at the last letter. Does it hum like m?

how.name: Check Every Letter
steps: Say the sound for each letter.
Blend them together.
Does it match what you heard?
Now you try it!

practice.sayText: Type the word am. I am five. Am.
practice.why: Am has two sounds: the sound in apple, then mmm. So it is a, m.
practice.hint: Say am slowly. First the apple sound, then hum.

how.name: Stretch and Spell
steps: Say the word slowly and stretch it out.
Write a letter for each sound you hear.
Now you try it!

questions.why: The story says Tam is a little blue crab who lives in the bay.
questions.hint: Listen to the first page of the story again.

how.name: Look Back
steps: Tap Read me the story and listen to the beginning.
Listen for the words that tell who Tam is.
Now you try it!

questions.text: What happened first, next, and last?
questions.why: First Tam sat on her mat. Next a wave took it. Last Max brought it back.
questions.hint: What was Tam doing before the splash?

how.name: Retell It
steps: Think about the beginning of the story.
What happened in the middle?
How did it end?
Now you try it!

questions.why: A big wave splashed and took Tam's mat away, so she needed help to get it back.

how.name: Why Did It Happen?
steps: Find the problem in the story.
Ask: what made that problem happen?
Now you try it!

questions.text: How did Tam feel when Max brought her mat back?
questions.why: Tam said thank you and shared her mat. Friends who say thank you and share are happy.
questions.hint: What did Tam say to Max? What did she do next?

how.name: Story Clues
steps: Listen for what Tam says and does.
Think: how would you feel if a friend helped you?
Now you try it!

stops.title: s, d
stops.why: With s and d you can read lots of new words, like sad, dad and Sam. Now you can read a whole story by yourself!

learn.text: s says sss, like the start of snake.
d says the sound at the start of duck.
learn.say: The letter d. It says the sound at the start of duck.

story.title: Sad Tam
pages: Sam sat. Tam sat. Sam, Tam, a mat!

practice.text: Read the word. Which picture matches it?
practice.why: Sss, then the sound in apple, then the sound in duck. Sss-a-d: sad!
practice.hint: Start with the first letter. It hisses like a snake.

how.name: Tap and Blend
steps: Touch each letter and say its sound.
Blend the sounds together, smooth and fast.
Now you try it!

practice.text: Read the word. Which picture matches it?
practice.why: D, a, d. The word starts and ends the same way: dad!
practice.hint: Look at the first and last letters. They are the same.

how.name: Tap and Blend
steps: Touch each letter and say its sound.
Blend the sounds together.
Now you try it!

practice.text: Build the word sat. Tap the letters in order.

say.a: the sound at the start of apple
say.t: the sound at the start of tiger

practice.why: Sat starts with sss, then the sound in apple, then the sound in tiger.
practice.hint: Say sat slowly. Which sound hisses first?

how.name: Say It, Build It
steps: Say the word slowly, one sound at a time.
Find a letter for each sound, in order.
Now you try it!

practice.text: Does it start like snake or like duck?
practice.why: Sun and sock start with sss, like snake. Dog and donut start like duck.
practice.hint: Say each name out loud. Does it hiss at the start?

how.name: Listen for the First Sound
steps: Say the picture's name out loud.
Is the first sound like snake or like duck?
Now you try it!

practice.why: Mmm, then the sound in apple, then the sound in duck. Mad!

how.name: Check Every Letter
steps: Say the sound for each letter.
Blend them together.
Does it match what you heard?
Now you try it!

practice.sayText: Type the word sad. The crab is sad. Sad.
practice.why: Sad has three sounds: sss, the sound in apple, and the sound in duck. S, a, d.
practice.hint: Say sad slowly and write a letter for each sound.

how.name: Stretch and Spell
steps: Say the word slowly and stretch it out.
Write a letter for each sound you hear.
Now you try it!

questions.why: The very first page says: Sam sat.
questions.hint: Look at the first page of the story.

how.name: Look Back
steps: Find the first page of the story.
Read it again, one word at a time.
Now you try it!

questions.why: Tam sat at Sam's mat. Then Sam was mad. Tam took her spot!
questions.hint: What did Tam do right before Sam got mad?

how.name: Why Did It Happen?
steps: Find the page where Sam is mad.
Look at what happened just before.
Now you try it!

questions.text: How do Sam and Tam feel at the end?
questions.why: At the end they both sit on the mat together. Sharing means they are friends again.
questions.hint: Look at the last page. Are they sitting together?

how.name: Story Clues
steps: Read the last page again.
Think: what do friends do when they make up?
Now you try it!

questions.why: First Sam sat. Then Tam sat at her mat. At the end they sat together.

how.name: Retell It
steps: What happened at the beginning?
What happened in the middle?
How did it end?
Now you try it!
